title: Four-page business site with WordPress import and SEO audit
what: Synthetic four-page business website: page map, responsive HTML templates, WordPress page import file, sitemap, robots file and a per-page SEO audit.
shows: Pages generated from one page map, importable into WordPress staging, each passing ten SEO checks: titles, descriptions, viewport, indexing, canonical, headings, alt text, links.
checks: every page scores 100 on the SEO audit
audit flags a deliberately broken page
sitemap and WordPress import match the page map
done: Page map and responsive HTML templates
remaining: WordPress theme and plugins on staging
limits: Synthetic brand and copy; static HTML, not a live WordPress theme; audit is a stdlib check, not a full Lighthouse run.
